team-inbox.title: Den Team Inbox
team-inbox.store: notes/<id>, members/<nick>, meta/sync (Firefly fills them after tools/team/inbox.py)

wolf-bench.title: Wolf Bench
wolf-bench.store: notes/<id> (GrumpyDingo's marks: type pin|arrow|pen, text, tag, sev must|should|nice, status open|fixed, rig, joint + local lx,ly (arrow lx2,ly2; pen pts), phase/standing, part; Firefly writes reply + fixedIn); checklist/hero3 (answers by question id)

gait-tracker.title: Gait Tracker
gait-tracker.db: clips/<clip id> = key points (source-video px), footfalls, own points; results/<clip id> = per-frame points and angles, per-stride curves; backups/<clip id>~<ms> = dated copies (auto every 10 min while working, manual from File)
